DECLARATION_THIS_DOCUMENT_CONTAINS_A_SUB.owner_decision: Emitted on the owner's explicit instruction, 2026-08-21, with this declaration committed by hash into the document.
DECLARATION_THIS_DOCUMENT_CONTAINS_A_SUB.safety_of_the_probe: No Authorization header exists anywhere in the probe source; no pod id appears; method GET on the collection root only; execution role limited to AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole. All five samples returned HTTP 401, which the probe asserts as a precondition.
DECLARATION_THIS_DOCUMENT_CONTAINS_A_SUB.what_it_DOES_NOT_measure: The guardian executing a STOP. It excludes the guardian's own post-activation-gate dispatch, and excludes everything requiring a real authorisation against a real pod.
DECLARATION_THIS_DOCUMENT_CONTAINS_A_SUB.what_it_actually_measures: DNS resolution + TCP connect + TLS handshake + HTTP request-to-first-byte, unauthenticated GET to https://rest.runpod.io/v1/pods from a preproduction Lambda matching the guardian stop proxy (python3.12, arm64, 128 MB, 8 s, us-west-2).
DECLARATION_THIS_DOCUMENT_CONTAINS_A_SUB.why_substituted: The real STOP path is unreachable under INERT (_activation_gate raises DEPLOYMENT_IS_INERT), and reaching it requires LIVE, which requires this very document. A genuine STOP additionally requires a real pod, which is behind Gate 4.
